title: 'The Recall's Three Notes' quest text said 'Two notes are known' even after Fry's rhyme fully described all three ('two notes rising, and a third that drops away') and Hollis had hummed and confirmed the exact shape of the third note — the game only credited the third note once I did the separate, explicit 'read the roll's cadence' action at the lodge hall, which felt redundant given what I'd already been told twice.
where: The Hunt's Stand — the Boy's Stair / Lodge Hall

evidence.quote: 'The Recall's Three Notes' quest text said 'Two notes are known' even after Fry's rhyme fully described all three ('two notes rising, and a third that drops away') and Hollis had hummed and confirmed the exact shape of the third note — the game only credited the third note once I did the separate, explicit 'read the roll's cadence' action at the lodge hall, which felt redundant given what I'd already been told twice.
